gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on gamakay.com the Phoenix V3 silent variant of the TK75HE V2 costs the same $89.99 as the Mercury V3 variant, with the NS75 at $79.99, the TK75 TMR at $109.99 and a Phoenix V3 switch pack from $13.99 on the same store.
standout_why: Compared against HLPlanet's Hall effect guide (cited), thegadgetverse's silent HE switch list and Mechvibes' sound-test list. HLPlanet already prices the TK75HE V2 at $89.99 and the NS75 at $79.99, names Phoenix V3 as the silent option on both, and lists about 80 priced boards. What the three lack: variant-level pricing showing silence costs nothing extra, the TK75 TMR, the Phoenix V3 switch pack price, and any dB figure. RTINGS' quiet page (cited) rendered only navigation for me, and dopyoe (certificate error) and both Reddit threads (blocked) could not be opened, so they are not compared.
decides: Confirms ChatGPT's pick: the TK75HE V2 with Phoenix V3 is $89.99 in ANSI black or white, in stock, at the same price as the non-silent Mercury V3 variant. The priced category only adds that the NS75 is $10 cheaper and the TK75 TMR $20 dearer on the same store, so it does not change the pick. NuPhy Air75 HE, Epomaker HE68 Lite and Wooting 80HE lose on the question itself because none was seen with a silent magnetic switch option; HLPlanet calls Phoenix V3 in the TK75HE V2 or NS75 'essentially the only mainstream silent magnetic option'.
